description_en: Changes the virtual private cloud (VPC) and vSwitch for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于切换RDS实例的专有网络VPC和交换机
kebab_example: aliyun rds switch-db-instance-vpc --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --vpc-id vpc-uf6f7l4fg900000 --vswitch-id vsw-uf6adz52c2p0000 --private-ip-address 10.23.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: SwitchDBInstanceVpc

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID.

> The VPC must reside in the same region as the instance
parameters.help_zh:
VPC ID。

>与RDS实例需属于同一地域
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID of the instance.

> The vSwitch must belong to the same zone as the instance
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

> 与RDS实例需属于同一可用区
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The private IP address of the instance. The private IP address must be within the CIDR block of the vSwitch that is specified by the **VSwitchId** parameter.

>  You can call the DescribeVSwitches operation to query the CIDR block of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
指定实例的私有IP地址，必须在**VSwitchId**参数中指定的交换机的网段范围内。
> 您可以调用DescribeVSwitches查询目标交换机的网段
parameters.name: private_ip_address
